key_concepts: The sun is the main source of heat and light
Sunlight brightens Earth and helps people see objects in their surroundings
The sun rises in the east and sets in the west
The sun's position affects temperature and weather on Earth
A shadow is a dark area formed when straight light rays are blocked by opaque objects
Shadows form when light strikes opaque objects
Shadows change position during the day because the sun's position changes
Morning and afternoon sunlight strikes objects at an angle and creates long shadows
At noon the sun is directly above the horizon and little or no visible shadow forms

Slanted light rays produce longer shadows
